sourceText:
Easy Orange Chicken Stir Fry Recipe [AIP, Paleo]
By: Paleo Flourish
Published: Thursday, June 28, 2018 - 10:59pm

Ingredients




2 Tablespoons avocado oil
2 chicken breasts, diced
1/2 teaspoon of salt
1 navel orange, peeled
1 Tablespoon tamari soy sauce or coconut aminos
1 teaspoon of fresh ginger
4 cloves of garlic, peeled

Preparation

1 Stir fry the diced chicken breast in the avocado oil – sprinkle the salt on it. 2 Make the orange sauce by blending the navel orange with the tamari sauce, ginger, and garlic. 3 Once the chicken starts to brown, add in half the sauce. 4 Stir fry on high heat until the liquid disappears. 5 Serve with more sauce if needed.

About

DESCRIPTION: Orange chicken can be healthy and easy to make.
